name: grimmsnarl_ml_v28
policy: Use the AlphaTCG-conditioned v25 ranker for ordinary prize races and switch to the synchronized v22 ranker after public wall evidence. Apply the measured one-ply planner, deck-clock guard, proactive wall trajectory, and reactive wall breaker. No belief search and no mirror-Froslass veto.

wall_ranker.activation: public Crustle/Cornerstone-style wall card or Neutralization Zone

wall_tank.interpretation: the observed v25 deficit is concentrated here

multi_pick_policy.source: unchanged v22 fallback derived from 3710 exact-deck top-pilot replays
multi_pick_policy.reason_unchanged: contexts 22 and multi-pick context 5 bypass the ranker but already match elite search budgets

wall_trajectory: concentrate spare Punk Up energy on one Morgrem
complete a one-energy Morgrem without starving Adrena-Brain
reserve the last Bench slot for a missing wall route
deterministic_guards.wall_break: avoid ineffective attacks and preserve/use the non-ex breaker route
deterministic_guards.deck_clock: veto an optional lethal Lillie refill in a long winning game

removed_from_v27.belief_search: removed: 301 considered, 23 searched, 336 branches, zero overrides in the v27 ladder replay
removed_from_v27.mirror_froslass_veto: removed: inherited v24 lever was previously measured at -72.7 Elo and non-causal

policy_escalation.reason: The AlphaTCG default is teacher code 3; enabling the old Froslass class switch would restore the refuted v24-era intervention.

promotion_contract.expected_policy_footprint: at least 50 changed single-pick decisions per 35 games versus v22
promotion_contract.measurement: submit v28 and v22 simultaneously in the same ladder window
primary_cells: second-seat turn-2 Grimmsnarl ex and attack access
promotion_contract.do_not_claim: A 34-game standalone rating cannot establish a sub-130-Elo improvement

validation.static_validation: PASS; 60 cards, 19 unique cards, zero warnings
validation.extracted_archive_import_smoke: PASS; both rankers and every optional component loaded

known_limits: Teal Mask Ogerpon is a structural Grass-weakness race and is not solved by the wall switch.
The race advantage and wall recovery come from observational cells, so v28 remains a challenger until paired measurement.
The exact archetype's known matchup fixes explain about 25 Elo, below the roughly 78 Elo estimated for top 50 and 192 for top 10. A stable +200 cannot honestly be guaranteed by this policy change.
description: Measurable v25/v22 mixture: current-pilot race policy, synchronized champion wall specialist, no dead search.
